findings.title: Authorized compilation is not bound to configured catalog membership
findings.impact: A structurally valid full record outside the configured v0.6 catalog can be compiled on a cache miss, cached, and returned under the configured catalog ID.
findings.required_fix: Seal configured source fingerprints and identities; make authorized reads cache-hit only; bind them to a typed visibility-owner receipt; test forged-record rejection and zero cache delta.

findings.title: Executable readiness is caller-controlled rather than registry-attested
findings.impact: A caller can re-sign a projection-only or synthetic semantic spec as active and obtain a legal AI candidate without an executable handler.
findings.required_fix: Separate projection status from executable readiness and require a sealed coordinator-owned readiness and handler-capability receipt before candidate emission.

findings.title: Non-card capabilities are admitted as CardSemanticSpec effect operations
findings.required_fix: Move military and shared capabilities to their domain specs or the shared operation registry; reject them inside CardSemanticSpec unless emitted by a card compiler contract.

findings.title: AI privacy validation permits hidden information in allowed value channels
findings.required_fix: Use a viewer-scoped producer with closed target-reference and explanation-token registries and test hidden sentinels embedded in values, not only forbidden keys.

findings.title: PlayerFace localization authorization is self-asserted
findings.required_fix: Compose a real localization/query port that deterministically maps semantic IDs to message/token IDs and emits a bound authorization receipt.

findings.title: Information scope represents source access rather than effect disclosure
findings.required_fix: Add explicit effect and result visibility policies and project both PlayerFace and AI information boundaries from them.

findings.title: Golden fixtures have no automated consumer
findings.required_fix: Add one focused test that loads all three fixtures and compares live compiler output, source SHA, semantic bodies, and fingerprints exactly.

findings.title: v0.4 and v0.6 catalog authority remain composed together
findings.required_fix: Retire the explicit v0.4 compatibility owner before claiming one authoritative catalog or unified execution.

findings.title: Production AI still reads raw card fields and localized names
findings.required_fix: Keep an explicit ratcheting allowlist and migrate AI to authorized observations and candidates without score, order, privacy, or RNG drift.

findings.title: Production UI still uses raw skill data and legacy alias chains
findings.required_fix: Cut consumers over through one PlayerFace adapter, then remove aliases atomically.

findings.title: RulesProjection and execution parity are not implemented
findings.required_fix: Add RuleExecutionPlan, sealed operation handlers, and semantic-to-existing-executor parity before three-projection or training cutover claims.

findings.title: Random operations have no explicit randomness policy
findings.required_fix: Add approved randomness-policy and existing RNG owner/draw-order references before random operations can become active.

findings.title: Integration evidence hard-codes boundary conclusions
findings.required_fix: Replace literals with adversarial calls and cache metric assertions.

findings.title: Performance gates are absolute rather than comparative
findings.required_fix: Record stable pre-cutover startup and projection baselines before hot-path adoption while keeping the 60-second cap.

no_findings.subject: second_card_semantic_state_owner
no_findings.detail: The semantic cache is derived and owns no card instance or world state.

no_findings.subject: new_ui_rule_reimplementation

no_findings.subject: new_ai_raw_payload_access
no_findings.detail: Raw effect payload access is confined to compiler input; the new AI projector does not read it.

no_findings.subject: per_candidate_compilation
no_findings.detail: Repeated AI projection leaves compiler cache metrics unchanged.

no_findings.subject: unsafe_composition_or_executor_connection
no_findings.detail: Composition commit instances three passive sibling services and adds no connection.
